SELECT VAL_DATE AS VAL_DATE, PTL_ID AS PTL_ID, SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, SUB_NAME AS SUB_NAME, FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, SECURITY_QUANTITY AS SECURITY_QUANTITY, UNIT_COST AS UNIT_COST, SECURITY_COST AS SECURITY_COST, CTNWR AS CTNWR, MCP AS MCP, SMV AS SMV, MCR AS MCR, VALUE_ADDED AS VALUE_ADDED, SUSPENSION_INFO AS SUSPENSION_INFO, EQUITY_INFO AS EQUITY_INFO, IMP_MODE AS IMP_MODE, SECURITY_COST_ORI AS SECURITY_COST_ORI, SMV_ORI AS SMV_ORI, VALUE_ADDED_ORI AS VALUE_ADDED_ORI, CCY AS CCY, EXCHANGE_RATE AS EXCHANGE_RATE FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB
AND PTL_ID = #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
union all SELECT sum.VAL_DATE AS VAL_DATE, sum.PTL_ID AS PTL_ID, subject.SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, subject.SUB_NAME AS SUB_NAME, NULL AS FINPROD_ID, sum.SECURITY_QUANTITY AS SECURITY_QUANTITY, sum.UNIT_COST AS UNIT_COST, sum.SECURITY_COST AS SECURITY_COST, sum.CTNWR AS CTNWR, sum.MCP AS MCP, sum.SMV AS SMV, sum.MCR AS MCR, sum.VALUE_ADDED AS VALUE_ADDED, sum.SUSPENSION_INFO AS SUSPENSION_INFO, sum.EQUITY_INFO AS EQUITY_INFO, sum.IMP_MODE AS IMP_MODE, sum.SECURITY_COST_ORI AS SECURITY_COST_ORI, sum.SMV_ORI AS SMV_ORI, sum.VALUE_ADDED_ORI AS VALUE_ADDED_ORI, sum.CCY AS CCY, sum.EXCHANGE_RATE AS EXCHANGE_RATE FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB sum ,RSK_VALTBL_SUBJECT subject
sum.SUB_CODE = subject.SUB_CODE
AND sum.PTL_ID = #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND sum.VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
